description: This file defines a NestJS controller for email verification endpoints related to 'atoms' in the application, including sending verification codes, checking verification requirements, verifying codes (both authenticated and unauthenticated), and managing verified emails.

classes.name: AtomsVerificationController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling email verification endpoints for atoms, including sending codes, verifying codes, and managing verified emails.

methods.name: sendEmailVerificationCode
methods.description: Handles POST request to send an email verification code.

methods.name: checkEmailVerificationRequired
methods.description: Handles GET request to check if email verification is required.

methods.name: verifyEmailCode
methods.description: Handles POST request to verify email code without authentication.

methods.name: verifyEmailCodeAuthenticated
methods.description: Handles POST request to verify email code with user authentication.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmails
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve verified emails for a user.

methods.name: addVerifiedEmails
methods.description: Handles POST request to add a verified email for a user.
